bibl.title: Le Ellenice di Ossirinco, Diodoro e il problema storiografico dell'inizio dell'egemonia spartana.
bibl.seg: Ugo Fantasia, Le Ellenice di Ossirinco, Diodoro e il problema storiografico dell'inizio dell'egemonia spartana.
bibl.note: In choosing spring 402 as the beginning of the first year of the Spartan ascendancy, the historian of the Hellenica Oxyrhynchia followed the seasonal chronology he borrowed from Thucydides. The idea that the real close of the Peloponnesian War was the autumn of 403 was developed in the Isocrates' circle and reflected a vision of the recent past in the light of the swift recovery of the Athenian power in the first decades of the IVth cent. BC.
